    Alle Klassen und Schnittstellen

    Klasse
    Beschreibung
    AddObstacle
    Factory for creating and placing grid-aligned obstacle shapes on the course pane.
    AimIndicator
    Draws a dynamic aim indicator showing ball power and direction (stub).
    App
    JavaFX application entry point for the GolfIt client.
    Ball
    Client-side ball model holding pixel position.
    BallRender
    Renders a golf ball as a JavaFX Circle on the game pane, scaling to grid size.
    Channel
    Tracks per-channel state including sequence numbers and pending acknowledgements for reliable delivery.
    ChannelManager
    Manages logical communication channels between a client and the server.
    Client
    Main client class for the GolfIt network client.
    ClientApi
    Client API for interacting with the game server.
    ClientCli
    Processes user input from the CLI and dispatches slash commands to the client API.
    ClientHandler
    Handles a single connected client on the server side.
    ClientHandler.ClientState
    Tracks whether a client is in the menu or actively playing a game.
    Commands
    Available CLI slash commands.
    ConsoleManager
    Manages console I/O using JLine to allow log output without disrupting the user's input line.
    Constants
    Global configuration constants for timeouts, packet sizes, and retry limits.
    Course
    Defines the mini-golf course layout by placing terrain obstacles (walls, sand, ice, water, trees, switches, and the golf hole) onto an 80x45 grid within a fixed 1100x600 pane.
    EventBus
    Simple publish-subscribe event bus for decoupling UI components from network handlers.
    Game
    Manages the fixed-size 1100x600 game world and scales it to fit the available screen space.
    GameView
    Transparent overlay pane that captures mouse drag input for aiming and shooting.
    HelpGridMap
    Development utility that converts the visual JavaFX course into server-side data structures.
    IClientApi
    Defines the client-side API for sending protocol messages to the server.
    IServerApi
    Defines the server-side API for sending protocol messages to clients.
    JLineAppender
    Logback appender that routes log messages through ConsoleManager to avoid disrupting JLine input.
    Lobby
    Represents a game lobby that groups players together before and during a match.
    Lobby.LobbyStatus
    Lifecycle states of a lobby.
    LobbyMenu
    Sidebar component for lobby management.
    Main
    Entry point for the GolfIt application.
    MapData
    Contains pre-computed map data for the server-side physics engine.
    MapData.ServerShape
     
    MessageBuilder
    Builder class for messages.
    MessageParser
    Parser class for messages.
    MessageParser.Message
    Represents a parsed message.
    MovementHandler
    Handles movement update messages from the server on the client side.
    MovementHandler
    Handles movement input messages from clients on the server side.
    PendingPacket
    Represents a sent packet awaiting acknowledgement, tracking its send time and retry count.
    PingService
    Periodically pings the server to measure latency and detect disconnections or server restarts.
    Protocol
    Defines all protocol constants including packet types, channel identifiers, special IDs, and functional interfaces.
    Protocol.PacketDispatcher
    Function that dispatches a parsed message to the appropriate handler.
    Protocol.SendFunction
    Function that transmits a raw message string over the network.
    Server
    The GolfIt game server.
    ServerApi
    Implements server-side actions: sending responses to clients, managing usernames, and broadcasting messages.
    ServerBall
    Represents the server-side physical state and behavior of a golf ball.
    ServerContext
    Provides access to shared server state: connected clients, lobbies, usernames, and session ID.
    ServerGameSimulation
    Manages the server-side physics simulation for all active players.
    ServerGameSimulation.GameEndListener
    Callback fired when all players in a lobby have finished.
    ServerGameSimulation.StrokeListener
    Callback fired when a player's ball enters the hole.
    ServerInit
    Handles server startup output including the ASCII art banner.
    Sidebar
    Chat sidebar with three modes: broadcast, private, and lobby chat.
    SplashView
    Premium splash screen for the GolfIt application.
    SystemHandler
    Handles system-level protocol responses on the client side (connection confirmations, chat, lobbies, movement updates).
    SystemHandler
    Handles all system-level protocol messages on the server side (connect, disconnect, chat, lobbies, movement).
